svg.title: One operator. Independently owned projects.
svg.desc: The same human and agents work across independently owned products. The map shows identity and responsibility, not health, adoption or invented dependencies. System model: One operator. Independently owned products.. HUMAN. Direction and authority The goal and its limits. CODING AGENTS Bounded tasks, named owners. PLAY / GAMES BB Bubbles FT Fighter SS SHOALSHOT P11 Protocol 11. BUILD / TOOLS AC App Composer AH Asset Hunter. EXPLORE / OTHER WORK FM LoftwahFM · MX MAX SC Social Club · PR Pirates. Project markers identify work, not activity or health. Each project owns its identity, source, data and release gates.
